articles.title: Jensen Huang returns to NVIDIA as President, CEO and Board Director
articles.summary: Today, the NVIDIA Board issued a statement on their official press area to note that they've reinstated Jensen Huang as President, CEO and Board Director.

articles.title: Kotlin Benchmark 2.0: How AI Coding Agents Handle Harder Tasks and Closed-Source Code
articles.summary: In July, we released the Kotlin Benchmark – a collection of 105 real repository-level tasks for evaluating AI coding agents’ work with Kotlin. Since then, we’ve updated it to be more representative of what Kotlin teams do, with more reliable results and more data to help you choose an agent-model configuration.

articles.title: Z.ai follows OpenAI into loop transformer territory with its new 750B flagship model
articles.summary: Z.ai is moving its flagship GLM-5.4 model to a loop architecture in which 28 layers run twice, which the company says lets the 750-billion-parameter model match models with 2 to 3 trillion parameters.

articles.title: Contra Force NES to SNES, 60fps Conversion
articles.summary: Developer Infidelity has just released his latest NES to SNES port, this time for the game Contra Force. As usual, there’s the reduced (or eliminated) sprite flicker or slowdown, but this conversion also allows the game to run at a stable 60fps!

articles.title: iOS 27.3 adds new features in six iPhone apps, details here
articles.summary: iOS 27.3 is coming soon , and it’s a big update for new iPhone features, including additions that span six built-in Apple apps. Here’s what’s new.

articles.title: How Modern Smartphones Talk To Satellites
articles.summary: There is another, entirely different concept for satellite communications for modern smartphones. That is—what if a satellite was just a cell tower, that a phone could talk to using its regular modem like any other?

articles.title: Probing DNS at Cloudflare
articles.summary: This is something the Cloudflare DNS team has experienced firsthand. In one rollout of the service that publishes DNS records to our edge, a scheduling bug let some record changes sit unpublished for hours.

articles.title: ‘Galaxy Watch 10’ won’t launch in 2027 as Samsung tries to slow RAMageddon losses
articles.summary: According to a new report, Samsung’s next “Galaxy Watch 10” won’t be releasing in 2027 with the company moving to a bi-yearly release schedule for its smartwatches.

articles.title: Stop-motion horror game ABIDE brings a freaky new trailer
articles.summary: Cult art-driven indie dev duo Talha & Jack Co showed off an intense new trailer for ABIDE - their upcoming stop-motion, first-person horror. Read the full article on GamingOnLinux .

articles.title: Creating Polars Expression Plugins in PyCharm: A Step-by-Step Guide for Rust Beginners
articles.summary: Polars is a favorite among data scientists. It’s a high-performance, columnar DataFrame library written in Rust and powered by Apache Arrow. Unlike traditional single-threaded tools, Polars uses full multicore CPU parallelism, efficient memory allocation, and lazy execution with query optimization.

articles.title: Code coverage uploads now flag invalid report formats
articles.summary: Previously, these uploads appeared to succeed, but no coverage showed up on your pull requests. Now you’ll find out about the problem in the workflow run, with a clear next step.

articles.title: Wii on Wii U – Finally Fixed!
articles.summary: Developer GaryOderNichts – the same dev who came up with the fix to prevent bricked Wii U’s – has just discovered why Wii games played via the Wii U’s “vWii” backward compatibility mode look so bad.

articles.title: AirPods Pro 3 were worth the upgrade for one standout feature
articles.summary: AirPods Pro 3 ( now only $149 , down from $249 ) offer many advantages over AirPods Pro 2, but after a year of use, the improvements to Active Noise Cancellation alone have proven worth the upgrade.

articles.title: Which Samsung folding phone is right for you? Galaxy Z Fold 8, Ultra, or Flip 8
articles.summary: You can get the Galaxy Z Fold 8, Fold 8 Ultra, and Flip 8 from your favorite carriers and retailers, but Best Buy is one of the best places to score a great deal with solid trade-in values and deep discounts around Black Friday and throughout the holiday season.

articles.title: Grab a Black Friday deal with the new Fanatical Capcom Bundle
articles.summary: Finish up your collection of Capcom games in the Fanatical Black Friday Bundle . If you don't already have a bunch, this can work out to be one of the best ways to grab a nice mixture of games.

articles.title: Adding One More Agent: How AI Team Size and Formation Shape Productivity and Diversity in Human-AI Brainstorming Teams
articles.summary: Generative AI has improved individual productivity, but whether adding a plurality of AI partners helps or hurts remains open. We crossed AI partnership (one versus two) with behavioral formation (calibrated to average human behavior versus customized by the participant) in a brainstorming experiment ($N$=168) with human-human dyads as reference.

articles.title: Pixel Weather rolls out ‘Report current weather’ to ‘improve local forecasts’
articles.summary: The main change today is a “Report current weather” feature to “Share the current weather condition to improve local forecasts.” The card appears at the very bottom of your current location and can be moved up the feed.

articles.title: Surreal corporate horror deckbuilder Mr Magpie's Harmless Card Game arrives February 2027
articles.summary: Mr Magpie's Harmless Card Game is a surreal corporate horror deckbuilder combining Minesweeper-inspired deduction, push-your-luck mechanics and more. During the Horror Game Awards 2026 they revealed a release date for February 18, 2027.

articles.title: Coherence by Construction: Synthesizing CTI Knowledge Graphs and the Formal Limits of Coherence Validation
articles.summary: Synthesizing relational training data such as knowledge graphs with a large language model typically emits structured objects one at a time, which keeps each object valid but leaves the relationships between them ungrounded.

articles.title: iOS 27 has a clever fix for unreliable Wi-Fi connections
articles.summary: iOS 27 includes a really clever new feature that aims to solve the awkward middle ground between cellular and Wi-Fi connectivity. Here’s how it works and how you can turn it on.

articles.title: TOUMAII: A 4.5M-Pair Tool-Calling Preference Dataset and Its Source-Agnostic Generator
articles.summary: To autonomously execute multi-step tasks, enterprise agents must reliably interact with tools, call APIs, or query databases, making tool-calling a fundamental capability of AI models.

articles.title: ChatAtom: A Multi-Agent LLM System for Molecular Dynamics Simulation and Visualization
articles.summary: Molecular dynamics (MD) simulation resolves atomic-scale motion and predicts the structural, mechanical, and dynamic properties of materials, making it cen- tral to materials design and discovery.

articles.title: VKD3D 2.2 Released With More Improvements For Direct3D 12 On Vulkan
articles.summary: Ahead of the Wine 12.0 release candidates expected to begin in December with the stable Wine 12.0 release then in early 2027, VKD3D 2.2 is now available for this Direct3D 12 on Vulkan API implementation.

articles.title: Mesa 27.0 Merges LLVMpipe AVX-512 Support
articles.summary: As a follow-up to the article last month around David Airlie and AI resurrecting AVX-512 support for Mesa's LLVMpipe software driver, that code is now merged for Mesa 27.0.

articles.title: Automating encryption at rest with Canonical’s Charmed MongoDB
articles.summary: That’s enough with the warnings; let’s dig into how encryption at rest works in MongoDB. Canonical’s Charmed MongoDB Operator supports data encryption at rest of the data using a two-level key hierarchy, and is local to each instance.

articles.title: High Tide (Linux TIDAL client) adds support for DLNA, Chromecast
articles.summary: High Tide, the open-source TIDAL client for Linux, can now play to Chromecast and DLNA devices like TVs and smart speakers. The feature rolls out in v1.8.0, released this weekend with a variety of smaller bug fixes and minor bumps, including showing artist names over Discord RPC.
